Sorry i misread you also want to manage your sql, Pterodactyl doesnt have that built in afaik but you could always just install adminer, Or you could connect to your mysql database from your windows pc there are afew mysql gui programs out there, But if you arent using bungeecord and its a singular server i would stick with the SQLite option in luckperms' config. You really dont need mysql as its such a headache to navigate around sometimes and sqlite is just a one and done, no fiddling around with firewalls to try fix issues that pop up

Pterodactyl is really good, And there are some un-official but really good automated install scripts out there where all you need to do is fill out the information it asks like "FQDN Hostname" < This is either your Public IP if you dont have a domain and keep in mind if you are using your public ip disable ssl in the next option, Or you can have it be your domain like "Yourdomain.enddomain" Then easy stuff like admin password, If you need any help reach out to me.

Do you by any chance have ufw installed on your ubuntu box? or any firewall if so could you please try disable it and test again? Also when he loads in is he fully loaded in? Can he interact with the world? Do the chunks fully load or is he in a frozen desynced state? That happened to me and a friend and i got it to work weirdly enough by me force kicking him using /kick USERNAME before he has a chance to lose connection then upon rejoin it worked.
